'''Seluket''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that featured numerous stone monuments that were centuries old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, glowing patterns appeared on the monuments, and investigations into the monuments revealed that the patterns warned of an impending ecological disaster.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Light in the Sky}}</ref>
